comment: Bluetooth LE advertising channel PDU: a 16-bit header (PDU type, RFU, ChSel, TxAdd, RxAdd, then the payload length in bytes), the payload, and a CRC-24 over header and payload, every field least significant bit first. On air the packet is preamble and access address (the ble_adv_aa word, not whitened), then this, whitened

payload_fields.name: adva
payload_fields.comment: AdvA (ScanA for a SCAN_REQ, InitA for a CONNECT_IND): sent low octet first, shown as written (most significant first)

payload_fields.name: ad
payload_fields.if: type == 0 or type == 2 or type == 4 or type == 6
payload_fields.comment: AdvData / ScanRspData: AD structures, each a length, then an AD type and length - 1 bytes
